The intro text for this event varies, and could be any of the following:
*''"You look like a military vessel. We're trying to get back to our homes alive. I'm an engineer by trade and could try to improve your reactor if you have any extra supplies."''
*''You receive a message from a small convoy. They're looking for some military supplies and are offering to try to improve your reactor in exchange.''
*#Agree to the trade.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;[ {{Transaction|3-5|subtract_missiles}} {{Transaction|0-2|subtract_drones}} &nbsp;]&nbsp;&nbsp;or&nbsp;&nbsp;[ {{Transaction|0-2|subtract_missiles}} {{Transaction|2-3|subtract_drones}} &nbsp;]&nbsp;&nbsp;or&nbsp;&nbsp;[ {{Transaction|2-3|subtract_fuel}} {{Transaction|0-2|subtract_missiles}} {{Transaction|0-2|subtract_drones}} &nbsp;] &nbsp;<span style="color:grey">[ the required amount of resources is shown before you make the choice ]</span>
*#*''You make the exchange and their team comes on board to try to improve your reactor.''
*#**Your ship <span style="color:limegreen">reactor</span> is upgraded.
*#Respectfully decline.
*#*''You decide you need what supplies you have.''
*#**Nothing happens.

==Notes==
This event is called "TRADER_UPGRADES_EXCHANGE" in the datafiles.
* Bug: having a maxed-out reactor does not prevent the trade, though you will simply lose the designated amount of missiles, drone parts, and/or fuel.
